name: Biochemistry, Molecular Biology and Biophysics (BMBB) Graduate Program
summary: BMBB doctoral research in biochemistry, molecular biology and biophysics, with first-year rotations across BMBB and MCDB&G.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application
publishedDeadlines.note: No year stated; fall admission only.

applicationFee.note: $75 U.S. citizens/permanent residents; $95 international. Central office does not waive fees, but GSDO offers targeted waivers for eligible U.S. citizens/permanent residents seeking a first graduate degree, with qualifying preparation/recruitment participation. Request before submission/payment.

english.toefl: 79 with W21/R19 before January21,2026; 4.5 total/W/R on or after
english.note: IELTS writing/reading6.5; DET Fall2027 total/writing/reading120. Test within2years of program start. No TOEFL MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. Qualifying education exemptions depend country, credits, recency and physical attendance.

documents: Personal statement, maximum two single-spaced pages
Unofficial transcripts; official after accepting admission
requirements.note: Significant productive research experience makes an application competitive. Competitive GPA3.3, not hard minimum. Recommended year each calculus, organic chemistry and basic biology including biochemistry/genetics. Research-focused letters preferred. Separate applications for MCDB&G; identify faculty in each if applying to both. Optional supplemental research description.

funding.note: All students receive stipend/fellowship; tuition, fees and health insurance supported. Student pays5% medical premium. Fall2026 published hourly rate$36.77, not an annual stipend; confirm current offer terms.
